**Top finding:** The concrete diagnostic implementation is correct against the frozen K-A A1 partition frozen in source, the raw counter is unchanged, and there is no untrusted adapter wiring. Combined execution on this tree is honestly undisclosed but not claimed. Scope is a nonsecurity review only; security judgments are not supplied here.

All checks were read, hash, and git-only. No source was altered and no build, test, model, native, or network operation ran.

## Candidate verification

HEAD is `c07f0f320c3a8535c36399529b514a2945b02c83`, matching the prompt. All 56 hashes in [MEMBERSHIP.json](/home/charl/Moriarty/.moriarty-dev/runtime/sherlock-reference-20261015/combined-c07-review/MEMBERSHIP.json) match the working tree exactly, and `git diff --check` against `ba12e473` is clean. The frozen [main.k](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/models/sherlock/k/main.k) hash `b3746ff5…` and the unchanged `reference_tests.rs` (`0138a704…`) and `reference_display.rs` (`3f3456bf…`) match the retained GREEN result, confirming that K and normal inputs are untouched.

## Source integration — APPROVE

The only new executable surface is two diagnostic functions. [reference_types.rs:150](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs:150) implements `is_resource_limit()` as `matches!(self, Self::Exhausted | Self::Rejected(4))`. [reference_types.rs:190](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs:190) implements `checked_charged_steps()` as `initial_fuel.checked_sub(remaining_fuel)`. The raw getter at [reference_types.rs:185](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs:185) retains its original `initial_fuel - remaining_fuel` body and panicking invariant, now documented as a precondition. No other file's executable behaviour changes.

A grep confirms that no consumer outside `sherlock/` calls either new function or the machine. In particular, `reference.rs` itself has no executable-body change: the diff against base contains only three rustdoc blocks (`Machine`, `step`, `run`), visible in the full diff. The pre-existing `examples/sherlock_reference.rs` still calls `Machine::run()` as before; it is unchanged in the membership and was not connected to any CLI, LSP, MCP, compiler, source `/1`–`/2`, Quint, Candidate B, Clean, native, or ledger input path by this candidate.

[mod.rs](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/mod.rs:22) declares `resource_tests` under `#[cfg(test)]`, and [check-reference.py:35](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/models/sherlock/reference/check-reference.py:35) lists `resource_tests.rs` in `SOURCE_PATHS`, so the new tests are inside the byte-bound source set rather than an unbound side file.

## SPEC compliance (nonsecurity) — APPROVE

`resource_tests.rs` asserts the partition across five tests: partition exhaustiveness over all `Rejected(0..=255)` codes, off-by-one frame-cap boundaries at limits 0, 1, and 2, publication precedence of free `Done`/`Rejected` over exhaustion at zero fuel, and an invalid hand-built snapshot returning `None` from `checked_charged_steps()`. The asserted rule lines and charges in [resource_tests.rs:69](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/resource_tests.rs:69) follow directly from reading `reference.rs`: Push fails when depth equals `stack_limit` ([reference.rs:82](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference.rs:82)), publication at lines 80/82 precedes the zero-fuel exhaustion arm at line 84, and `Exhausted` leads through `(84, 0)`. The independent derivation matches the test expectations, so expectations are not copied from implementation output.

The header discrepancy in `reference_oracles_tests.rs` is now correctly documented. The candidate differs from the tested GREEN bytes only in the `//!` doc block at [reference_oracles_tests.rs:1](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_oracles_tests.rs:1), which now says `check-reference.py` "verifies literal JSON transcription before compiling/running" instead of the older single-line claim, which correctly matches what the script does (regenerate, byte-compare, then compile the actual module graph with `rustc --test`). [INTEGRATION-SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP.json:41](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/docs/audits/2026-10-15/sherlock-resource-diagnostics/INTEGRATION-SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP.json:41) records exactly that sole difference and explicitly states "No new execution of the combined current tree is claimed." The 8-pass/5-fail RED and 13-pass GREEN captures are likewise correctly attributed to the isolated `sherlock-resource-diagnostics` worktree in [README.md:30](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/docs/audits/2026-10-15/sherlock-resource-diagnostics/README.md:30), and [SHERLOCK-REFERENCE-STATUS.md](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/docs/SHERLOCK-REFERENCE-STATUS.md) retains the same honest boundary. The two GREEN hash deltas (`reference.rs`, `reference_types.rs`) between RED and GREEN match the stub-to-implementation transition, so the provenance chain is internally consistent.

The R1 Muse SPEC `REQUEST_CHANGES` defect — an unqualified Opus routing instruction — is repaired. [SKILL.md:37](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/plugins/moriarty-dev/skills/develop/SKILL.md:37) now reads "for new work this is temporarily superseded by the October 15 AGY Argon assignment above until Opus availability is observed," and [execution-focus.md:62](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/plugins/moriarty-dev/skills/develop/references/execution-focus.md:62) carries the same qualifier. The old Muse approval was not borrowed; the repair is in the operative text itself. The borrowed approval is also not borrowed: this review was formed from a fresh read of the candidate at `c07f0f3`.

The correctness loop document is honestly classified. [SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md:3](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/docs/SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md:3) states that the harness "is not implemented or executed yet," and [line 116](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/docs/SHERLOCK-CORRECTNESS-LOOP.md:116) preserves the "no execution authority" boundary. All 35 UIREQ identifiers are retained: the spec file still lists UIREQ-001 through UIREQ-035 and the extra scenario in UIREQ-026 points at the loop ([spec.md:182ff](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/core-continuations-20261015/openspec/changes/sherlock-universal-interpreter-design/specs/universal-interpreter/spec.md:182)). All SHA256SUMS entries under the design change verify, every relative Markdown link in the loop, tasks, clean-stage, README, plan, and plugin documents resolves, and the publication binding is unchanged for the original files. The loop adds only a development workflow document; it does not implement Quint, Lean/Clean, handwritten circuits, or adapters for carrying untrusted inputs.

## Quality — APPROVE

The implementation is minimal, matches sibling style (a `const fn` predicate on the enum and a `const fn` checked accessor alongside the existing raw getter), and the documentation states its non-authority, non-transferability across profiles, and operator quarantine scope without overclaiming. The tests are table-driven around exact state observations (rule, charge, depth, charged steps, outcome) rather than colluding with a second evaluator, so a silent change to frame-cap or precedence semantics would fail rather than be masked.

No material defect, including the classification of diagnostic code versus omitted ceilings, was found. B1–B8, H2/Q2, the rejected H1 closure, the fragmented `U/M/MC/SP/G/ZR/MNR` denominators, and the resource-task accounting under `H1` remain open by design. Native authority remains ZERO, unchanged.

## Limits and next work

The candidate has no honest execution evidence on this combined tree; before any claim that these tests pass here, run the guarded `check-reference.py` against this exact tree (not the isolated diagnostics worktree), and record that result separately from the borrowed checkpoint evidence. Whole-crate Cargo, K runtime, Quint, Lean/Clean, the B model, SDK/native export, and ledger settlement all remain unrun and unaccepted by this review. Halting H1 remediation — host wall-time, allocation, native-stack, and depth ceilings — needs the real Argon security review to design; this review cannot stand in for it, and none was taken here.
